news.title: Chip and AI stocks rally premarket as Nvidia recovers, CoreWeave beats
news.text: Nasdaq-100 futures were indicated up roughly 1.6-1.9% and S&P 500 futures up about 0.7-1.0% ahead of the open, led by chip and AI names. CoreWeave's results reassured investors on AI infrastructure demand, and Nvidia extended a recovery from its prior two sessions' losses tied to the board's probe into CEO Jensen Huang over an alleged foreign-intelligence contact. Micron and AMD were also indicated higher premarket.

news.title: Nvidia board's Jensen Huang probe still an overhang into today's session
news.text: Nvidia's board opened an internal investigation on 9 Nov into CEO Jensen Huang over reports tying him to a contact U.S. intelligence identified as a foreign agent; the board says it has found no sign national security or trade secrets were compromised. Shares fell as much as 8% intraday on the news before paring the loss, and remain down sharply from the early-October peak - today's premarket bounce is a partial recovery, not a resolution; the review is ongoing.
